RAF
Oversees all 7 of the processes to quantify and issue real property with mineral assets.
▼
THE ASSET
CERTIFICATION
Mine Certification
01

RAF certifies the mine, validating gold reserves at international standards before anything enters the system.

  • 1
    Real Asset Foundation is the first point of contact for mine certification.
  • 2
    RAF coordinates independent geological surveys to establish verifiable reserves.
  • 3
    Gold certification meets NI 43-101 international standards.
  • 4
    All mines follow RAF's 43-99 certification process for in-situ recognition.
FEEDS INTO → Tripartite Estate & Mineral Trust
LEGAL STRUCTURE
Tripartite Estate & Mineral Trust
02

Legal separation creates a dedicated mineral trust, isolating subsurface assets from surface land rights.

  • 1
    The Tripartite Declaration separates the estate into three parts: mineral, biological, and social.
  • 2
    The mineral estate conveys Earth Blocks to the bioregional mineral trust.
  • 3
    Each Earth Block is quantified and tied to certified gold reserves.
FEEDS INTO → Earth Blocks
THE UNIT
Earth Blocks
03

Physical gold reserves carved into standardized 5m cube units — the atomic unit of the entire RealGold ecosystem.

  • 1
    Earth Blocks are 5m × 5m × 5m units of subsurface mineral real property.
  • 2
    Each block compiles geolocation, title, chain of custody, and mineral data into one auditable packet.
  • 3
    Each Earth Block is sent to the Registry and prepared for both DST issuance and RealGold tokenization.
FEEDS INTO → The Registry
THE FOUNDATION
The Registry
04

The immutable source of truth — connecting the physical asset to both investment paths.

  • 1
    Holochain-based ledger using UNYT accounting for transparent, tamper-evident records.
  • 2
    Tracks Earth Blocks, DST allocations, ownership history, and compliance verification.
  • 3
    Conveys allocations to both the DST and tokenization paths and records all transactions.
  • 4
    RAF oversees all seven processes to quantify and issue real property with mineral assets.
FEEDS INTO → DST Path & RealGold Token Path
THE MARKETS
INVESTMENT PATH
DST Path
05

Section 1031-qualified exposure to certified mineral real property for traditional real estate investors.

  • 1
    RAF structures the DST for section 1031 exchange qualification — backed by certified mineral real property.
  • 2
    Allows traditional real estate investors to participate through a familiar, IRS-compliant vehicle.
  • 3
    Investors can bridge between paths, converting DST interests to tokens or tokens to DST positions.
FEEDS INTO → Market Coordination & Regulation
DIGITAL PATH
RealGold Token Path
05

Brings in-situ mineral real property on-chain, bridging physical gold and digital markets.

  • 1
    The RealGold Token provides digital market access — backed by the same certified mineral real property as the DST.
  • 2
    Both instruments are backed by identical Earth Blocks in the Registry, ensuring parity of underlying value.
  • 3
    Investors can bridge between paths, converting tokens to DST positions and vice versa.
FEEDS INTO → Market Coordination & Regulation
OVERSIGHT
Market Coordination & Regulation
06

RAF enforces compliance across both markets — IRS, SEC, and digital asset regulations — keeping the system audit-ready.

  • 1
    RAF coordinates DST and token markets through the Registry, ensuring IRS, SEC, and digital asset compliance.
  • 2
    Owners access provenance records, Earth Block models, and full transaction history through the Registry.
  • 3
    Dual-market oversight ensures both traditional and digital investors operate under consistent compliance frameworks.
FEEDS INTO → Fiduciary & Stewardship
STEWARDSHIP
Fiduciary & Stewardship
07

Gold stays in the ground permanently — RAF's ultimate commitment to environmental integrity and long-term value.

  • 1
    RAF holds fiduciary responsibility across the entire system — Registry, DSTs, tokenization, and stewardship.
  • 2
    Minerals stay permanently in situ, stabilizing both DST and token markets while funding environmental reclamation.
  • 3
    This permanent in-situ commitment is RAF's foundational promise: Earth Based Currencies that respect the land.
